profile.headline: Staff Software Engineering Lead at Qualcomm
profile.summary:
i am currently a full stack developer at ViaSat. On the front end I use TypeScript in Angular 2 and JavaScript, and also do a significant amount of back end work in NodeJS using TypeScript. I also work with Python, C# / Dotnet and Bash scripting. I also Dockerize our projects.

 Previously I was a Software Engineer 2 at Northrop Grumman. While on a rotational program, I designed and wrote a software disk programming tool, to be used by non-engineers in the field, significantly reducing time spent by end users preparing deliveries. This work included front end GUIs and back end database work. Python and bash scripting was also incorporated. My more recent work involved a wide range of disciplines, from web development (Javascript and Java REST client) to C# / .Net application development for a radar control client. 
I also traveled during my rotations, working directly with customers and servicing software. 

On my spare time, I work on small web projects. In addition, I constantly research newer software technologies for my professional growth.

I was a computer science graduate from the University of Maryland, Baltimore County with a cumulative 3.38 GPA and 3.53 major GPA. 

I previously worked as a cybersecurity intern; my areas included Java and Python scripting. I also worked as an undergraduate Teacher's Assistant at UMBC teaching Python and assisted in writing and editing lab and coursework.
